name: Level 1 Triangle-Voxel Classification
definition: Classifies input triangles into a coarse 3D voxel grid by mapping vertices to voxel indices and testing overlap with all candidate voxels the triangle spans.
summary: Level 1 Triangle-Voxel Classification maps triangle vertices to voxel indices to identify candidate voxels, enabling efficient parallel processing by avoiding exhaustive voxel-triangle testing.
